subject: Private VPC architecture walkthrough — next steps & slot pick
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@mednex.com>, Priya Chopra <priya.chopra@mednex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Aug 2028 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture walkthrough — next steps & slot pick

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — really useful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can line up a technical walkthrough (private VPC / on-prem packaging) with our infra and ops leads: 

Recap (short):
- Goal: Evaluate Private VPC deployment for Mednex production traffic (HIPAA-sensitive).
- Key constraints: customer-managed VPC, private Egress to partner APIs, 99.9% availability target, and HSM integration for keys.
- Current ask: technical architecture deep dive + ops prerequisites call to validate network and security assumptions.

What I propose:
1) 60–75 minute architecture walkthrough with our infra engineering + ops (we'll cover network, IAM, routing/failover, and runbook items).
2) Pre-call checklist (attached) to collect subnet ranges, expected peak qps, and any compliance docs you can share.
3) Slots (US-PST timezone) — can you pick one?
   - Wed Aug 9, 10:00–11:15 PT
   - Thu Aug 10, 13:00–14:15 PT
   - Fri Aug 11, 09:30–10:45 PT

Attendees from our side: Hannah (AM), Marissa (Customer Success), Connor (Infra lead). Please let me know who from Mednex will join (network/security engineer + one product/owner recommended).

Attachments: arch-readiness-checklist.docx, sample-network-diagram.pdf (short templates to speed prep).

If those slots don't work, tell me two alternatives next week and we'll adapt. Once we confirm a time I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@mednex.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Chopra <priya.chopra@mednex.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 02:14:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture walkthrough — next steps & slot pick

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear recap. All sounds good. We're keen to review the architecture and validate the network/egress path. For attendees, I'll have:
- Me (Sanjay Rao, IT lead)
- Priya Chopra (Security Architect)
- Omar Hussein (Network Engineer) — added him in a follow-up invite after I check his calendar.

Of the proposed slots, Thu Aug 10 13:00–14:15 PT works best for us (that is Fri Aug 11 01:30–02:45 IST). Please go ahead and lock that.

Two quick asks before the call: 
1) Can you include a short section on expected token-latency profiles for warm vs cold KV-cache behavior? That will help Priya validate SLO expectations.
2) We have a question about bringing our internal KMS (Vault) — we'd like to confirm whether Redwood's Private deployment can integrate with customer-managed HSM/KMS (we discussed briefly). If you can send a short note and link to your KMS integration doc ahead of the call that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sr. IT Lead, Mednex Health
sanjay@mednex.com

Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture walkthrough — next steps & slot pick

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks for confirming the Thu slot. I've penciled it in on our side for Thu Aug 10, 13:00–14:15 PT. I'll be the technical lead on the call and will walk through network routing, KV-cache warmup behavior, and options for customer-managed KMS. In prep, a couple items that will help make the call productive:

- Please share the expected peak qps and typical request size (tokens) if you can. That lets us size batching and latency expectations.
- If you plan to use Vault/HSM, confirm whether you can provide a temporary test key for staging or if you prefer only integration design discussion at first.

I'll include a short slide with warm vs cold latency numbers from a comparable private deployment and a brief ops runbook outline.

Calendar invite and agenda coming from Hannah shortly.

Connor O'Brien
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com

Thanks all — calendar invite sent. Quick notes we've added to the invite: 
- Agenda: 1) Network & routing requirements (20m), 2) KMS/HSM integration options (15m), 3) Latency profiles & caching behavior (15m), 4) Ops runbook & next steps (10m).
- Pre-call asks: Sanjay / Priya — please upload the arch-readiness-checklist (attached) to the Drive link in the invite before EOD Wed Aug 9 if possible.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/MDX-2028-004

Looking forward —
Hannah
